method: Ordinary 2013 photograph and standard viewer PMTiles/Mapzen. Existing documented nominal dimensions and historical datum retained without bespoke re-research.

pictures.author: Andrzej Wójtowicz
pictures.usage: Viewed in browser only; no copied pixels or image textures.

observations: Unequal stone river arches and brick approach arches
Different low and pyramidal pier projections on opposite sides
Pale stone parapets, raised prayer niche and opposite balcony

vector.note: The extract keeps zooms 0-maxLevel, so the archive also carries layers the app never reads: landcover (zoom 0-7), earth, boundaries and places.

limitations: The observed photo epoch does not establish current river stage or urban construction.
Existing historical dimensions, reconstructed vault profiles and 241.5 m bottom reference are not a current engineering survey.
